properties.statement: [BL-209] orphan_node counts AUTHORED_BY as attachment, so 22 Decisions — three of them ACCEPTED — are invisible to the one detector that exists to find them
properties.value: {"evidence": "*Found 2026-08-04 while recording the embeddings discussion: propagate_from on dec:idea-embeddings-adoption returned 0 impacted, yet detect_defects did not flag it.* The Decision orphan check (heal.rs:733) is outgoing(..).is_empty() | | incoming(..).is_empty() \u2014 any edge of any type counts as attachment. Every node authored through the tools carries an AUTHORED_BY edge to a Contributor, so a Decision needs only its own provenance to read as attached. MEASURED on the committed export: 238 Decisions, 125 of them decision:ack: (excluded deliberately and correctly, ver:acknowledgement-not-structure), 14 with literally zero edges (the ones that DO fire), and 22 PROVENANCE-ONLY \u2014 invisible. Three of the 22 are accepted: dec:a-failing-check-says-against-what, dec:commitment-edges-survive-snapshots, and dec:export-once-per-pr. [BL-162] is the row this half-fixes: *\"An accepted Decision that governs nothing is invisible to every detector\"* \u2014 the fix catches the zero-edge case and misses the provenance-only case, which is the larger one. THE COST IS ALREADY PAID AND MEASURABLE: dec:export-once-per-pr is an accepted process rule that PR #70 violated, in a session that then wrote the same rule into [BL-208] as a discovery \u2014 the decision could not be found by propagation, by the detector, or by anything that governs it. The fix is in-house and one line of vocabulary: [BL-176] already solved this exact shape for Artifacts with ARTIFACT_BOOKKEEPING \u2014 *\"bookkeeping drawn by the machinery, not by anyone saying what the file is FOR \u2026 counting them as attachment would silence orphan_node everywhere\"* \u2014 and AUTHORED_BY is precisely that, but the Decision path uses no exclusion list at all. Generalise the exclusion rather than duplicating it, and check the same question for every other type the orphan check covers. WATCH THE BLAST RADIUS BEFORE SHIPPING: this will surface 22 decisions at once, and 19 are proposed brainstorm captures that may be correctly unattached \u2014 the row is not \"attach all 22\", it is \"the detector must be able to SEE them\". Size S", "origin": "Migrated from docs/backlog.md BL-209 on 2026-08-07 (epoch:backlog-retired). Size estimate carried from the row: S."}
